preconditions.description: The length of the binary string s must not exceed 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The binary string s must consist only of zeroes and ones.

postconditions.description: The output string t must have the same length as the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in t)
postconditions.description: The output string t must consist only of zeroes and ones.

postconditions.expression: sum(c == '0' for c in t) == max(sum(c == '0' for c in t) for t in valid_strings)
postconditions.description: The number of zeroes in t must be the maximum possible among all valid strings.

postconditions.expression: all(len(lnds(s[l-1:r])) == len(lnds(t[l-1:r])) for l in range(1, len(s)+1) for r in range(l, len(s)+1))
postconditions.description: For any substring of s, the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence must be equal to the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the corresponding substring of t.
